chk.miniWhenHidden: Show it while the auto-hiding taskbar is hidden (instead of the bar inside it)

note.monitors: One bar on every other monitor, each with its own content. The main bar stays on the main monitor.
note.noOtherMonitor: No other monitor was found. When you connect one it will appear here.
msg.listFailed: The list could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.

live.noRuntime: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime was not found; it is needed to play video.
chk.breakingEnabled: Breaking news: the main bar turns red with capital letters
lbl.duration: How long the bar stays red (minutes)
note.breaking: When a headline contains one of the words, the main bar turns red: first the app icon grows from the middle, then it fades and "BREAKING NEWS" shows. The red bar lasts as set above or until you open the headline.
note.live: If you add a live source (YouTube or web TV), a pulsing button appears on the bar while breaking news is active. Clicking it opens (and closes) a rectangular preview window with play/pause and maximize. It never opens by itself.
lbl.taskbarBarColor: Colour of the bar inside the taskbar
color.theme: Follow the theme (dark/light, Opsis and Windows)
lbl.defaultBar: Which bar is shown by default
note.defaultBar: The main bar can be the one touching the taskbar or the one built into it. Both can be shown together: turn on the second bar below.
lbl.barBackdrop: Background material of the main bar
lbl.taskbarBackdrop: Background material of the bar inside the taskbar
note.backdrop: Acrylic = state 4, Blur = state 3, Transparent gradient = state 2. They change the background only; text stays crisp.
help.text:
HELP — OPSIS NEWS CRAWLER
=========================

What it is
A news and price bar that scrolls on your desktop: above the taskbar, inside it, at the top of the screen, in the centre or wherever you place it.

Common problems
• I cannot see the bar → make sure no app is fullscreen (the bar hides there on purpose) and that the position is on a visible screen.
• No news load → check your internet connection and that the source (RSS) is ticked in Sources → News flow. With no connection the bar shows the last stored data with a message.
• An article I read does not come back → by design; use "Reset read list" in Settings → General.
• Prices are delayed → Athens prices are always 15 minutes behind (official Euronext Athens files; the bar no longer prints the delay, the limitation is stated here and in Sources → Markets flow). Shares of other Euronext markets are closing prices, ECB rates update once per working day. Metals, crypto and oil/natural gas are near-live; if their source does not answer, the last known price is shown with a label.
• I see "The connection to provider … is not working" → that provider does not answer; the bar shows the last stored data and retries by itself.
• The transparency is not visible → Windows "Transparency effects" must be on (Windows Settings → Personalisation → Colours).

• No sound on urgent items → check Settings → Breaking → "Alert sound", the Windows volume and that the app is not muted.
• The weather map does not open → it needs internet and the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime; check that "Click a city…" is on in Sources → Weather flow.
• Severe weather warnings → they come from the Open-Meteo forecast for the city you choose in Settings → Breaking. They are not the official HNMS bulletin; for official guidance see emy.gr and meteoalarm.org.

Files
• Settings: %AppData%\OpsisNewsCrawler\config.json
• Read articles: %AppData%\OpsisNewsCrawler\read.json
• Previous closing prices: %AppData%\OpsisNewsCrawler\quotes-cache.json
• Last stored data (no network): %AppData%\OpsisNewsCrawler\cache\

Data sources
• Athens prices: Euronext Athens, trade files delayed by 15 minutes.
• Metals and cryptocurrencies: gold-api.com (free service, real-time prices).
• Currencies: ECB reference rates through Frankfurter (once per working day).
• Shares of the other Euronext markets: closing prices (Euronext list).
• Weather: Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), refreshed every 15 minutes.
• If something does not load: Settings → General → "Open the log file".
• Oil and natural gas: Pyth Network (Hermes, near-live index prices) with the daily U.S. EIA prices through FRED as fallback.
• Prices are not investment advice.
instructions.text:
HOW TO USE
==========

On the bar
• Click an item: opens the article in your browser and marks it as read.
• Mouse over an item: the bar pauses and a card shows picture, source, time and summary.
• Mouse wheel: changes the scroll speed.
• Right click: opens the settings.

Settings (one navigation rail: Settings, Sources, Information)
• Settings → General: language, news category, speed, pauses, read articles, start with Windows, Ctrl+Alt+N hot key.
• Settings → Bars: what each bar shows (main, second inside the taskbar, one per monitor). Choose a content and, if you like, a second half: the bar is split in the middle and each half can be news (of any category), markets or weather.
• Settings → Bars → Placement and behaviour: above the taskbar, top of the screen, centre, custom (coordinates or mouse) or inside the taskbar.
• Settings → Bars → Desktop bar: a free bar on the desktop; choose what it shows (weather, markets, news), the style (rectangle, rounded or pill), size, place and whether it stays above windows. It also appears while an auto-hiding taskbar is hidden.
• Settings → Look: theme, transparency, colour, material and edge fade.
• Settings → Breaking: keywords, duration and live stream for urgent news ("HAPPENING NOW").
• Settings → Breaking also holds: the alert sound, and "Severe weather in my area" (choose a city; test button).
• Sources → News flow: websites (RSS) per category, your own category, test and order, "Read later".
• Sources → Markets flow: stocks, metals, commodities, currencies, price alerts and source status.
• On the bar: click a city of the weather line → a window with the weather and a map (maximize ⤢, close ✕ or Esc).
• Sources → Weather flow: cities and which details are shown (wind, gusts, humidity, feels-like, rain, cloud cover, pressure).
• Market analysis (tray icon or Sources → Markets flow): candlestick chart with SMA20/50 and Bollinger bands, back-test (SMA, RSI), fear & greed gauge and an optional assistant with your own Anthropic key.
• Sources → Markets flow → Price history: optional download of daily prices from Yahoo Finance (unofficial, off by default, at your own risk).
• Tray icon: Pause/Resume, Refresh, Market analysis, Portfolio, Exit.
• Information: Help, Instructions, History, License and Updates.

Tips
• "Add from website": type a site address and the program finds the RSS feed by itself.
• "Move with the mouse": the pointer jumps onto the bar and turns into the move cursor; drag the bar where you want it and drag its ends to change the width.
history.text:
VERSION HISTORY
===============

0.13.1 — 21/10/2026
• New: optional price history from Yahoo Finance (off by default, unofficial, at your own risk) so candles, the back-test and the gauge work from the first day; Bollinger bands on the chart.
• All new texts translated into the 12 other languages.
• Fixed: shares of other Euronext markets and the portfolio find their stored prices in the charts.

0.13.0 — 21/10/2026
• New: a "Market analysis" window with a candlestick chart, a back-test (SMA, RSI), a fear & greed gauge from the stored prices and an optional assistant using your own Anthropic key.
• The settings window has one left navigation rail instead of two rows of buttons; every bar setting (placement, content, desktop bar) is on the Bars page.
• Desktop bar: rectangle, rounded or pill (capsule) style; a new preview with a miniature screen and close-ups of every bar.
• Tray icon: one Pause/Resume item; the Opsis tray menu gets Close and Open.

0.12.8 — 20/10/2026
• New: when the taskbar hides automatically and the bar inside it with it, the desktop bar appears at the place and size you chose (option in Bars).
• The MotionDesk → Opsis rename is finished in the plugin folder too: the installer removes every old OpsisNewsCrawler.MotionDeskPlugin.* file.

0.12.5 — 20/10/2026
• New: a new application icon and an animated icon in the notification area: a little bar on which the news (newspaper), sports (ball), defence & diplomacy (shield with an olive leaf) and economy (chart and coins) pass from right to left. The icon is also in the installer; the animation can be switched off in the settings.
• New: two new news categories: "Defence & Diplomacy" (Defence Point, Defence Review, Militaire, Breaking Defense, Defense News, POLITICO Europe) and "Sports" (Gazzetta, in.gr, BBC Sport, ESPN).
• New: "Portfolio" window: the shares you own (quantity, average price) with live prices, value and profit/loss in euro, today's change, RSI and an SMA20/50 signal from the closing prices the program stores. Ideas from stonks-cli (MIT) and greek-stocks-ai. Not investment advice.
• New: dependencies: a page in the installer (.NET 10 Desktop Runtime, WebView2 Runtime — what is already there is shown ticked and locked, what is missing is downloaded from Microsoft with a signature check) and a Dependencies page in Information.
• Changed: the Position tab is now part of the Bars tab; all cards have the same width.
• Changed: the weather and map window opens at the far right edge of the screen and touches the top of the bar (or of the taskbar when the bar is inside it).
• Changed: the bar inside the taskbar slides together with an auto-hiding taskbar and takes its height.
• Changed: the plugin for Opsis was renamed OpsisNewsCrawler.OpsisPlugin.dll (was MotionDeskPlugin); the installer removes the old file.
• Fixed: the assembly version of the plugin contract (Plugin.Abstractions) stays 0.8.0.0, otherwise Opsis could not load a plugin built with a newer number.
• Merged with version 0.11.5.3 (alert sound, weather warnings, weather map, desktop bar, OPML, settings export/import, snooze from the tray).


0.11.5.3 — 19/10/2026
• New: clicking a city on the weather line opens a window with the city's current weather on top of a live OpenStreetMap map (Leaflet), with a maximize button and close (✕ or Esc). Works on every bar that shows weather, including the desktop bar. Can be turned off in Sources → Weather flow.
• The map needs internet and the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime; the tiles are OpenStreetMap's (© OpenStreetMap contributors).

0.11.5.2 — 19/10/2026
• New: an alert sound (a short triple beep, independent of the Windows sound scheme) when an urgent headline, a price alert or a severe-weather warning appears. Settings → Breaking → "Alert sound when something urgent appears".
• New: "Severe weather in my area" (Settings → Breaking): every 30 minutes the forecast of the next 12 hours is checked for the city you choose (thunderstorms, gusts ≥ 75 km/h, heavy rain, snow, heat ≥ 40 °C, frost ≤ −3 °C) and shown as an urgent item with the sound. It is an automatic warning from a forecast (Open-Meteo), NOT the official HNMS bulletin.
• New: temporarily hide the bars for 15 or 60 minutes from the tray icon; muted news keywords ignore accents.
• Fixed: price and weather alerts no longer vanish at the next news refresh.
• Fixed: the sound also plays when a new urgent headline arrives while the bar is already in urgent mode.

0.11.5 — 17/10/2026
• New: the settings now have three tabs — Settings, Sources, Information — with horizontal sub-buttons; the side menu is gone. Settings: General, Bars, Position, Desktop bar, Look, Breaking. Sources: News flow (with "Read later"), Markets flow, Weather flow. Information: Help, Instructions, History, License, Updates (the update frame moved here).
• New: the "small weather bar" is now the "desktop bar" and shows whatever you choose: weather, markets or news (and a split in the middle).
• New: the split in the middle is no longer limited to news and prices; each half can be news of any category (including your own), markets or weather. It applies to the main bar, the second bar, the monitor bars and the desktop bar.
• New: in the Weather flow you choose which details appear next to the temperature: wind, gusts, humidity, feels-like, rain, cloud cover, pressure.
• New: "Move with the mouse": the pointer jumps onto the bar, turns into the move cursor and you drag the bar anywhere (the desktop bar comes to the front while you move it).
• New: with no internet, or when a provider does not answer, the bar shows the last stored data (news, prices, weather) and a message: "No internet connection" or "The connection to provider X is not working", with the time of the data. Stored prices never trigger price alerts.
• New: Brent/WTI oil and natural gas near-live from Pyth Network; if it does not answer, the daily EIA/FRED prices. A status card for the price sources in the Markets flow.
• New: price alerts, Ctrl+Alt+N hot key (show/hide the bars), start with Windows, test and reorder (▲▼) RSS feeds, first-run settings.
• New: the breaking-news intro now reads "BREAKING NEWS · HAPPENING NOW".
• Changed: the "15 minutes delayed" message was removed from the bar; the limitation is explained in the Markets flow and in Help.
• Removed the "Save settings" button (there is "Apply").
• Fixed: crash "Cannot access a disposed object: ContextMenuStrip" on right click → Settings.
• Fixed: the bat file now finds Inno Setup 7 (and 6/5) in all usual folders and in the registry.

0.11.0 — 15/10/2026
• Improved: quote polling adapts to the selected source freshness (live, Athens delayed, Euronext end-of-day, daily energy/ECB).
• Fixed: preserve the market MIC when copying share instruments in settings.
• Fixed: remove duplicate watchlist entries and prevent duplicate Athens entries from aborting price loading.
• Improved: skip empty MICs in Euronext requests and deduplicate syndicated news with different URLs.
• New: initial unit tests and Windows CI for build, tests, and version consistency.

0.10.2 — 15/10/2026
• New: inside Opsis the update is downloaded, verified (SHA-256) and installed as soon as you close Opsis, after your confirmation.
• Improved: the log records the size of the bar inside the taskbar (to diagnose other PCs).

0.10.1 — 14/10/2026
• Changed: the small weather bar sits in the middle of the desktop with adjustable height and width and the same effects as the main bar (colour, transparency, material, fading ends).
• New: the tabs of the settings scroll (mouse wheel or arrows) instead of wrapping onto a second row.

0.10.0 — 14/10/2026
• New: weather for the prefecture capitals and well-known islands of Greece (71 cities): icon, temperature with one decimal, wind speed and direction, humidity.
• New: "Weather" as content for every bar, and a small weather bar on the desktop (drag it, click for the next city).

0.9.1 — 14/10/2026
• Fixed: prices now load source by source and no longer stay on "Loading prices…" when one source is slow or unreachable; a retry after 1 minute and a log file.
• New: "Show the bars" switch (settings and tray icon).
• New: cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, live) and currency rates (ECB).
• Fixed: the plugin inside Opsis was an old version in the 0.9.0 installer.

0.9.0 — 14/10/2026
• New: one bar on every other monitor, each with its own content.
• New: Ctrl+click on a news item saves it to the "Read later" list.
• New: proper right-to-left layout for Arabic (settings and bar).
• New: optional check for new versions on GitHub, with a verified download.
• New: "Select all / Select none" buttons for shares.

0.8.1 — 14/10/2026
• New: all Euronext shares (Athens, Paris, Amsterdam and more) with a choice of which to show.
• New: 14 languages like Opsis (app and installer).
• New: preview of the bars in the settings.
• Improved: less memory for pictures, safer download of pictures/icons and live preview, safer saving of settings.

0.8.0 — 13/10/2026
• New: tabbed settings in the Opsis look (also inside Opsis - Desktop Customization).
• New: Help, Instructions, Version history and License.
• New: the bar hides while another app (video, browser, game) is fullscreen.
• New: articles you have read do not show again.
• New: a bar inside the taskbar with its colours and transparency, fully clear.
• New: two bars; news, prices, or both split in the middle.
• New: Euronext Athens, metals, oil and natural gas prices.
• New: edge fade and transparency as in Opsis.
• New: one language system; every text is shown in the language you choose.

0.7.0
• Smooth scrolling, hover pause, preview card, source icons, RSS/Atom, 4 modes, tray icon, installer.

settings.importConfirm: Importing will replace the current settings. Continue?
settings.unsavedPrompt: You have unsaved changes. Choose Yes to save, No to discard them, or Cancel to keep editing.
chk.trayAnimated: Animated icon in the notification area
note.dependencies: The components the program needs. Those already on this computer are shown ticked and cannot be changed; for what is missing there is an install button (downloaded from Microsoft, signature checked before installing).
dep.webview2: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (live video preview, weather map)
msg.depNotSigned: the file is not signed by Microsoft
portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.empty: Add the shares you own (quantity and average price). The window shows value and profit/loss with live prices. Not investment advice.
portfolio.incomplete: Positions without a price yet are not counted.
col.name: Name
msg.badNumber: Enter a number greater than zero.
analysis.title: Market analysis
analysis.empty: There are no prices for this instrument yet. The history is requested from Yahoo in the background and fills in while the program runs.
analysis.legend: Filled candle = exact figures of the day (Athens trade file). Hollow = sampled from this program's refreshes. Lines: SMA20 (amber), SMA50 (blue). Not investment advice.
bt.result: Strategy: {0} %   Buy & hold: {1} %   Trades: {2}   Win rate: {3} %   Max drawdown: {4} %   Days in market: {5}/{6}
bt.notEnough: Not enough stored days: {0} needed, {1} stored. The history grows by one day for each day the program runs.
bt.disclaimer: A back-test uses past prices without fees and does not predict the future. A signal is traded at the next day's close. Not investment advice.
fg.comp.breadth: How many are above their 20-day average
fg.note: Computed by this program from the stored prices of the {0} instruments you watch. It is not the CNN Fear & Greed index. Every part is 0 (fear) to 100 (greed) and the gauge is their average. Not investment advice.
fg.notEnough: Not enough data yet ({0} instruments, {1} parts missing). About 50 stored days are needed for all five parts.
ai.intro: An optional helper for questions about the markets. It uses your own Anthropic API key; without a key nothing is sent anywhere.
ai.share: Send my prices and portfolio with each question
ai.noKey: Paste your key above and press "Save key". You can create a key at console.anthropic.com.
ai.privacy: Nothing is sent until you press Send. The key is stored encrypted for this Windows account and is left out of the settings export. Answers are not investment advice. Usage is billed to your own Anthropic account.
chk.yahooHistory: Download price history from Yahoo Finance (unofficial, at my own risk)
note.yahooHistory: Off by default. Charts and the back-test need history: if you switch this on, the program asks Yahoo for the daily prices of the last six months for your instruments (one request per instrument and day, one second apart) and stores them here. Yahoo's terms do not allow automated use: the choice and the responsibility are yours. No personal data is sent and no limit or protection is bypassed; if Yahoo refuses, the program stops for today. Stooq is not supported because it asks to prove you are not a robot.
analysis.emptyNoYahoo: No prices are stored yet. The program keeps one price per day while it runs; for an immediate history switch on the Yahoo download in Sources → Markets flow (an unofficial option).
